description: List all data centers and archive providers registered in the NASA CMR system. Returns provider IDs (e.g. GES_DISC, ORNL_DAAC, LPDAAC_ECS, PODAAC, NSIDC_ECS, LAADS, ASDC, GHRC_DAAC), organization names, URLs, roles, and consortium memberships. Use provider IDs as the "provider" parameter in nasa-cmr.datasets.search to scope dataset discovery to a specific NASA archive center. There are approximately 60 active providers covering distinct Earth science disciplines. Source: NASA CMR — US Gov public domain, no auth required.

page_size.description: Number of providers to return (1–100, default 50). There are approximately 60 active NASA CMR data centers.

name: nasa-cmr.providers.list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NASA CMR — List Data Providers
